title: Digital product roadmap and reconstruction feasibility
status: Proposed independent product design; no platform implementation or vendor procurement in this phase
recommendation: Build one AI-operated staffing platform with three role-based experiences. Own workflow decisions, policy versions and audit evidence; establish specialist services and choose one authoritative staffing record system.
planning_assumption: Start with one staffing service line, one specialty, one jurisdiction and one client/worksite group. This is a scope recommendation, not a claim the market or client has been selected.
operating_limit: AI can operate delegated administrative tasks. Licensed healthcare and education services, accountable employment/clinical decisions, contractual exceptions and financial release still need the relevant professionals and owners. The current research does not establish a zero-human company.

architecture.rule: Use one application with role-specific access initially; a native mobile app is optional later.
Agents propose or execute permitted actions through validated domain commands. The model is not the authority for payroll totals or credentials.

components: Selected ATS/CRM or minimal owned staffing core
architecture.rule: Assign one authoritative system per record class. Vendor IDs map to internal IDs; duplicate masters are not an acceptable integration design.
Provision the new operator's accounts and permitted integration scope. Amergis's accounts and datasets are not available inputs.

system_of_record_decisions.owner: Selected ATS/CRM by default; minimal owned core only if vendor criteria fail
system_of_record_decisions.boundary: Choose before implementation. Own workflow store holds IDs, state evidence and action history rather than a competing editable master.

system_of_record_decisions.records: Contract rules, requirement versions, approval policy
system_of_record_decisions.boundary: Store source, effective dates, unit, applicability, precedence and approved interpretation. An unresolved rate or rule stays unresolved.

system_of_record_decisions.owner: Restricted evidence store plus external issuing/screening sources
system_of_record_decisions.boundary: Document extraction is not verification; readiness uses person match, jurisdiction, status and freshness.
Preserve originals and amendments. Internal normalized entries reference source records and approval state.
Owned software prepares, checks and reconciles inputs. Final financial posting/release is separately authorized.

system_of_record_decisions.records: Agent actions, approvals, exceptions and reconciliation
system_of_record_decisions.boundary: Record actor, evidence, payload hash, policy/model version, idempotency key and outcome.

ats_selection_gate.default: Establish a suitable ATS/CRM for the initial pilot if it passes the integration criteria. Do not select solely because Amergis historically named a vendor.
required_evidence: Current documented read/write APIs for required records and status transitions
Permitted AI integration and customer data access under the applicable agreement
Scoped service accounts, field access and tenant isolation
Synthetic test environment or an acceptable documented test approach
Event/change support or reliable incremental reconciliation
Data export, attachments, identifiers, limits and operational support
Measured fit to the pilot journey and commercial terms
ats_selection_gate.fallback: If no candidate passes, build the minimal candidate–job–submission–assignment core for the pilot. Do not recreate an enterprise ATS feature catalog in parallel with buying one.
ats_selection_gate.vendor_status: Erecruit, Bullhorn, ADP, Certiphi, Nursys and MatterWorx are research leads or examples, not selected suppliers. No quotes, contracts or accounts have been obtained.

release_slices.name: Operating contract and vendor decisions
release_slices.build: Fix the pilot scope; define object ownership, allowed agent actions and one client requirement/rate pack.
release_slices.establish: Select ATS approach, payroll/accounting, screening/licensing and communication services; obtain permitted test access.
release_slices.exit: An explicit owner and authoritative system for each object; vendor integration gaps recorded; synthetic journey agreed.

release_slices.name: Candidate to approved placement
release_slices.build: Worker intake and consent, client requisition intake, evidence-linked matching, credential/onboarding queue and operations approvals.
release_slices.establish: A consented candidate population and real client demand; test credentials and screening packages for the chosen profession.
release_slices.exit: Synthetic duplicate, missing credential, rejection, withdrawal and approved placement cases behave correctly. No live employment decision delegated solely to a model.

release_slices.name: Assignment to reconciled money
release_slices.build: Shift confirmation, time intake/amendments, pay preparation, invoice draft and reconciliation views.
release_slices.establish: Contract-designated time source, payroll codes, billing rules, accounting connections and named financial owners.
release_slices.exit: No duplicate booking/pay batch/invoice on retries; pay and bill totals reconcile; a client invoice dispute does not automatically suppress earned-pay processing.

release_slices.name: Bounded live operation
release_slices.build: Enable approved reminders and record updates; raise task authority only after observed pilot performance.
release_slices.establish: Named exception coverage, client/worker agreements and live vendor scopes; thresholds set by accountable owners.
release_slices.exit: Measured errors, intervention rates and response times meet agreed limits; rollback, replay and escalation are exercised.

release_slices.name: Additional products and scale
release_slices.build: Multi-client programs, supplier/VMS portal, advanced analytics, native mobile or teletherapy administration only when their business lines are selected.
release_slices.establish: Additional contract/jurisdiction rules and relevant licensed services.
release_slices.exit: Each expansion has its own verified workflows, unit economics and regression cases; no assumption one client's configuration generalizes.

next_discovery_sprint.completion: Every transition has actor, prerequisite, evidence, output and exception route; observed behavior is separated from proposed design.

next_discovery_sprint.deliverable: One complete candidate-to-invoice journey plus duplicate, expired credential, canceled shift, corrected timecard and credit/rebill cases.
next_discovery_sprint.completion: No real personal or client data is required; expected outcomes are explicit. This is a proposed next implementation, not completed in this phase.

next_discovery_sprint.deliverable: Versioned API/schema exports, sample payloads, scopes and limits for shortlisted services.
next_discovery_sprint.completion: Each connector has an owner, authorized scope, source specification, retry/reconciliation behavior and a documented pass/fail decision.

next_discovery_sprint.deliverable: Synthetic worker, recruiter, client, supplier and payroll walkthroughs with an approved evaluation purpose.
next_discovery_sprint.completion: Record action semantics, states, validation and exports without assuming a support-form role label equals permission.

next_discovery_sprint.deliverable: Working intake-to-placement prototype over the selected record system, with an operations exception queue.
next_discovery_sprint.completion: Run the agreed positive and negative cases before any external action authority is enabled.

not_recoverable_from_public_evidence: Amergis's private candidate pool, customer CRM and payroll or invoice transactions
Actual production table definitions, custom fields, configuration and complete permissions
Private SOPs, matching algorithms, model prompts, conversion rates and operating unit economics
Current integration mappings and complete failure/retry behavior behind authenticated services
scope_of_this_phase: Product definition and reconstruction feasibility only. No vendor outreach, registrations, procurement, authenticated portal access or live workflow implementation.

portfolio.title: Independent digital product portfolio
portfolio.status: Recommended future operator design, not recovered Amergis architecture or a completed implementation
portfolio.design_position: One shared staffing platform with three role-based experiences. The 12 portfolio entries below are capability areas, not 12 separate applications. Establish specialist services; own workflow policy, controlled agent actions and operational evidence.

initial_slice.scope: One staffing specialty, one jurisdiction and one client/worksite group; healthcare versus education remains undecided.
initial_slice.journey: Client order → candidate consent and application → evidenced match → recorded human clearance and client decision → assignment → worked time → payroll preparation → invoice and reconciliation.
initial_slice.record_ownership: Choose a compatible ATS/CRM as authoritative owner of candidate, client, requisition, submission and placement records, or build a minimal owned core if no shortlisted system passes the integration gate. Never maintain two editable masters.
minimum_live_conditions: Operator-owned customer demand and consented worker supply
Approved requirement and contract rule pack
Selected services with permitted integration and test access
Named owners for employment, clinical, commercial and financial exceptions

products.name: Worker experience and public jobs
products.recommendation: One responsive web experience with public discovery and authenticated worker self-service; use established hosting/CMS where useful.
minimum_scope: Service pages and operator-owned job catalog
Assignment details, time submission handoff and support requests
products.phase: R1 intake/onboarding; R2 assignment/time; R3 live delegation
products.ai_scope: Normalize intake, explain missing information, send approved reminders and route worker requests.
products.human_boundary: Workers control consent and acceptance. Agents do not attest professional competence or clear a worker on their own.
products.evidence_note: Published job and app features establish comparable user needs; the future user experience is our design. Competitor listings are research data, not the new operator's fillable orders.

products.name: Client experience
products.recommendation: A client role in the shared application with access scoped to the relevant organization and worksite.
minimum_scope: Record client decisions and assignment confirmations
Time approvals or links to contract-designated timekeeping
Invoice evidence, service requests and basic reporting
products.phase: R1 order/submission; R2 time/invoice; R3 live delegation
products.ai_scope: Complete intake, prepare submission evidence, chase missing approvals and explain status.
products.human_boundary: The client makes assigned candidate and time approvals; agents cannot manufacture approval or override contract-specific processes.
products.evidence_note: MaxView marketing provides feature-level evidence; exact authenticated screens, permissions and current transition semantics remain unverified.

products.name: Operations and exception console
products.recommendation: One internal role-based workspace for recruiting, credentialing, account operations, finance and accountable reviewers.
minimum_scope: Evidence and proposed action side by side
Approve, reject, request correction and escalate
Credential and incident cases with restricted access
products.ai_scope: Assemble records, recommend actions, prioritize by approved policy and track follow-through.
products.human_boundary: Accountable reviewers own employment, clinical, disciplinary, contractual and financial decisions allocated to them. Approval binds to the exact action version.
products.evidence_note: Public roles and workflows support the functions; a unified AI approval console is an independent operating recommendation.

products.name: Workflow and agent execution core
products.recommendation: Own durable workflow states, approved domain commands and task-scoped agents; orchestrate the chosen record system through adapters.
minimum_scope: Assignment and shift transitions with atomic reservation
Timers, retries, approval version binding and exception routing
products.phase: R0 specification; R1 placement; R2 assignment/finance; R3 bounded execution
products.ai_scope: Extract, summarize, draft and choose permitted next administrative actions; deterministic guards enforce rules.
products.human_boundary: The model cannot invent missing rules, approve its own restricted action or treat uncertain verification as clearance.
products.evidence_note: Public API entities and workflow evidence guide the boundaries, not a recovered database schema. The workflow store contains references, evidence and action state rather than competing candidate/job masters.

products.name: Contract, time and financial preparation module
products.recommendation: Own effective-dated contract rules and preparation/reconciliation logic; establish payroll and accounting settlement services.
minimum_scope: Approved contract clauses, rates, units and precedence
Original time source references and amendment history
Separate pay eligibility and client bill approval
Variance queues, credit/rebill evidence and provider reconciliation
Expense and reimbursement preparation when included in the selected service model
products.phase: R0 rule pack; R2 complete; R3 controlled execution
products.ai_scope: Extract draft rules, identify anomalies, explain variances and assemble approval packages.
products.human_boundary: Authorized owners approve rule interpretation and financial release. Deterministic calculations use approved rules; customer invoice disputes do not automatically suppress earned-pay processing.
products.evidence_note: Public contracts show customer-specific variation. New contracts supply the production rules; published ceilings are not assumed negotiated prices or wages.

products.name: Integration, evidence and audit layer
products.recommendation: Build thin versioned adapters and an owned action/event ledger over established infrastructure.
minimum_scope: ID aliases and one owner per record type
Schema mapping and scoped service identities
Restricted document evidence with provenance and freshness
Reconciliation, replay, audit and action outcome metrics
products.phase: R0 contracts; R1 first adapters; R2 reconciliation; R3 operating telemetry
products.ai_scope: Classify and extract documents, explain integration errors and prepare remediation proposals.
products.human_boundary: Vendor outages, missing fields or stale events create explicit unknown states. AI does not invent transaction acknowledgements.
products.evidence_note: API documentation proves product capabilities, not Amergis-specific mappings or entitlement. Implement only selected, permitted operator integrations.

products.name: Staffing records and CRM
products.recommendation: Default to establishing an ATS/CRM only if its current API, AI-use terms, data scope, test approach and export pass the pilot gate. Otherwise build one minimal owned staffing core.
minimum_scope: Read/write transitions, export and incremental reconciliation
dependencies: R0 vendor fit and commercial review
products.phase: R0 decide; R1 establish or implement minimum fallback
products.ai_scope: Read and write permitted records through D04/D06; prepare evidence-based matches and follow-ups.
products.human_boundary: No duplicate editable candidate/job/placement masters. Historical Amergis use does not select a vendor for the new company.
products.evidence_note: Erecruit is a historical Amergis lead; Bullhorn ATS REST is a different interface. Neither product has been selected or procured.

products.name: Payroll, HR administration and accounting services
products.recommendation: Establish suitable payroll, tax, benefits/HR and accounting services, with clear ownership of employee setup, settlement and ledgers.
minimum_scope: Accounting postings, invoices, receipts and banking permissions
dependencies: Selected product edition and API entitlement
products.phase: R0 provider decision/setup; R2 integration; R3 live processing
products.ai_scope: Prepare inputs, compare results, flag inconsistencies and route service requests.
products.human_boundary: Separate preparation from release. Do not build a bespoke payroll-tax or funds-settlement engine for the pilot.
products.evidence_note: ADP is documented in Amergis support materials; Amergis edition and entitlements remain unknown. Accounting and other service choices are independent recommendations.

products.name: Screening and credential verification services
products.recommendation: Contract suitable screening and authoritative verification channels for the chosen profession and jurisdiction; build checklist orchestration in D04.
minimum_scope: Applicable requirement bundles and worker consent
Human readiness clearance and exception records
products.phase: R0 access/requirements; R1 onboarding; R3 live monitoring
products.ai_scope: Check completeness, organize evidence, reconcile vendor status and notify owners of changes.
products.human_boundary: OCR is not verification. Clinical suitability, adverse-result decisions and final work-readiness clearance remain with accountable people.
products.evidence_note: Certiphi and Nursys are research leads, not selected services. Nursys covers enrolled nurse licenses; education, therapy and other professions require their own applicable sources and test approaches.

products.name: Identity, communications and platform foundations
products.recommendation: Use established identity, messaging, e-signature, secure storage and infrastructure services; configure the operator's permissions and data handling.
dependencies: Provider terms appropriate to selected data/workflows
products.phase: R0 establish; R1 access and documents; R3 operational readiness
products.ai_scope: Send delegated messages, route support and prepare access/incident work with scoped credentials.
products.human_boundary: Security administration, sensitive access changes and incident accountability retain named owners. Do not assume a competitor's authentication vendor is the required choice.
products.evidence_note: Public login evidence demonstrates identity as a platform boundary. The service bundle and operating controls are our recommended foundations, not an inventory of Amergis vendors.

products.name: MSP and supplier management extension
products.recommendation: Add only if the company chooses an MSP business. Integrate a permitted client VMS or evaluate a new VMS; add supplier roles to the shared platform.
dependencies: Selected MSP business and client program
products.ai_scope: Distribute approved orders, track responses, reconcile program records and prepare service reports.
products.human_boundary: Supplier qualification, disputed allocation and contractual changes retain program owners.
products.evidence_note: Sunburst describes client-dependent VMS selection; MatterWorx is named for education. Public features support an independent design, not a universal Amergis VMS reconstruction.

products.name: Teletherapy administration extension
products.recommendation: If remote clinical services are selected, establish suitable video/session services and licensed content; build scheduling, access and reporting around them.
minimum_scope: Role-based room access and waiting workflow
dependencies: Licensed clinicians and accountable clinical owner
products.ai_scope: Schedule, remind, check documentation completeness and reconcile authorized activity records.
products.human_boundary: Licensed clinicians deliver treatment and assessments; AI administration is not autonomous clinical delivery.
products.evidence_note: Public ATP capabilities exist, but its API and underlying provider are unknown. Do not infer or copy licensed assessment content.

portfolio.source_reference_system: All source_ids refer to sources in outputs/amergis-api-reconstruction.json. Workflow IDs refer to outputs/amergis-blueprint.json. Recommendations extend the observed capabilities and are not assertions of Amergis internal design.
portfolio.acceptance_position: A product is not ready because its UI exists. Demonstrate the complete synthetic journey, negative/exception cases and cross-system reconciliation before delegated live actions. No automation ROI or headcount replacement estimate is supported by the current evidence.

reconstruction.title: Reconstruction feasibility and next evidence plan
reconstruction.basis: Synthesis of existing phase2 and phase3 evidence; no new network calls or portal access in this work package.
reconstruction.conclusion: We can build an independently designed staffing operating system from observed functions and public rules. Exact Amergis database, private workflow configuration, records and economics are not recoverable from this evidence. Vendor interoperability requires selecting products and proving their current tenant interfaces.

classification_legend.not_publicly_recoverable: Private records, organization facts and economics require authorized evidence; establish our own business data and relationships.

areas.boundary: No public API index, portal JavaScript, directory or job feed grants access to private business records or produces the commercial rights required to fulfill those jobs. Exact replication of Amergis internal database is not supported by the evidence.
acceptance: Every live candidate/client/order has a legitimate acquisition source, owner and relevant consent/authority
Synthetic and production records are clearly separated
No public competitor listing is represented as an owned client order
No claim of recovered Amergis database or live connector without direct evidence

state_machines.name: Application and client submission
state_machines.status: Proposed independent workflow, not recovered Amergis state machine

transitions.guard: Record source, person identity and consent scope; ask only needed missing facts
Required factual evidence assembled; no unsupported competency inference
Approve exact packet and job-related criteria; candidate agrees to disclosure
Packet unchanged, correct client/program scope, no duplicate submission
Distinct client selection and worker acceptance recorded; onboarding can still remain incomplete

exceptions: Disputed identity, accommodation or background flag routes to authorized reviewer, not automatic rejection
Worker withdrawal removes pending submission authority
Any packet change invalidates its previous approval
acceptance: A recruiter approval cannot manufacture client acceptance
A selected applicant is not automatically cleared for work

state_machines.name: Credential readiness and shift booking
state_machines.status: Proposed independent workflow; public evidence supports eligible-existing versus recruiter-review branch only

transitions.guard: Verification evidence collected with source, freshness, jurisdiction, restrictions and person-match status
Owner records clearance scope, validity and any restrictions
Expiry, restriction alert or unresolved contradictory evidence prevents reliance on prior clearance
Atomic reservation; current scoped clearance, worker consent, availability, client-approved shift and hour/conflict checks pass
Revalidate state versions and record required acknowledgements; reservation expiry releases slot

exceptions: Unknown candidate enters onboarding rather than automatic rejection
Conflicting or unavailable verification never implies clearance
Clinical fitness and disputed credential restrictions go to qualified owner
acceptance: Expire credential between approval and booking; no confirmed assignment
Race two booking requests; exactly one reservation succeeds
Worker receives no unrelated medical documents through the scheduling interface
state_machines.scope: Illustrative transition excerpt; not exhaustive or executable.

state_machines.status: Proposed independent workflow, not recovered financial implementation

transitions.guard: Preserve original record; validate source and flag overlap or missing evidence
Resolve payable hours and rates; bind approval to batch hash and pay period
Approved immutable payload, unique idempotency key and provider acknowledgement tracking
Contract-specific billing prerequisites satisfied; does not determine worker wage obligations

exceptions: Missing client billing approval keeps payroll review active
Rejected/disputed time remains in the ledger for resolution
Post-approval edits create a revision and invalidate affected approvals
acceptance: No duplicate payment or invoice under replay
Client dispute cannot silently erase or defer compensable hours
Payroll and invoice totals reconcile independently to their own source and provider records

state_machines.name: Incident and consequential exception handling
state_machines.status: Proposed independent workflow, not recovered clinical SOP

transitions.guard: Capture reported facts, urgency indicators and minimal routing data; do not diagnose or decide credibility
Send urgent safety concerns immediately to staffed clinical/HR route with receipt tracking
Owner conducts substantive investigation and records clinical, HR or employment determination
Track explicitly authorized actions and deadlines; preserve access restrictions

exceptions: Unacknowledged urgent case escalates through defined staffed backup
Agent uncertainty never closes the case
Conflicting evidence retained without invented resolution
acceptance: Urgent case gets a named owner and acknowledged route
Only authorized owner can enter substantive determination
Restricted case evidence does not leak into generic recruitment search or public chat

research_plan.work: Choose one service line, one client/worksite pattern and one assignment type; determine own-core versus chosen-ATS system of record. Use the 12-stage blueprint but defer MSP and teletherapy unless in launch scope.
research_plan.input: Existing public evidence plus operator decisions
research_plan.acceptance: Written in/out scope, named accountable owners, essential vendor shortlist and one synthetic candidate-to-invoice journey

research_plan.deliverable: Canonical contracts, state machines and fixtures
research_plan.work: Specify the independent schemas, status enums, versioned client rules, identity aliases and A/B/C action grants. Create synthetic normal and exception fixtures.
research_plan.input: Blueprint domains/tasks, public contracts, role and platform evidence
research_plan.acceptance: Source-linked requirements and executable tests cover duplicate IDs, stale clearance, concurrent booking, changed approvals, payroll/billing separation and retry

research_plan.work: For only the chosen ATS/payroll/screening/license providers, obtain permitted access scope, current specification, field/status dictionary, authentication/scopes, sample fixtures and event/import/export behavior. Confirm product-specific terms before evaluation.
research_plan.input: Vendor agreements and approved test arrangements
research_plan.acceptance: Each adapter marked simulated, documented, tested or production-enabled; absence of a sandbox handled explicitly. No unsupported Amergis connectivity assertion.

research_plan.work: Run worker, recruiter, client, credentialing and finance journeys in our prototype; use third-party synthetic demo only when evaluation scope permits. Record allowed actions, side effects and failed transitions.
research_plan.input: Prototype fixtures and role matrix; selected permitted demos if relevant
research_plan.acceptance: One complete role-isolated journey plus withdraw/cancel/correct/reject paths, with zero cross-tenant leakage in tests

research_plan.work: Run a supervised pilot on our own clients, worker supply and approved business data. Measure task time, exception frequency, reviewer overrides, errors and connector reconciliation before expanding authority.
research_plan.input: Real operating relationships, vendor integrations, named owners and predefined success thresholds
research_plan.acceptance: Documented outcomes support or reject each automation grant; measured evidence replaces speculative savings and task-count percentages

research_plan.work: Add program-specific supplier/VMS and clinical administrative integrations only when an actual customer and operating model require them.
research_plan.input: Executed program/service scope and permitted vendor testing
research_plan.acceptance: Separate configuration, roles, retained data and professional handoffs validated end to end

authority.A: Agent executes explicitly delegated routine action only after deterministic prerequisites and scoped permissions pass.
authority.B: Agent prepares; named owner approves the exact action version before execution.
authority.C: Qualified/authorized person leads judgment or attestation; agent handles logistics and documentation.
authority.boundary_note: These are proposed operating controls, not a claim every human gate is mandated by law everywhere. Clinical service, adverse employment decisions, professional attestations and material finance exceptions require specifically assigned authority.

unsupported_claims_to_avoid: Recovered Amergis database, source code or complete current organization chart
Vendor API availability proves Amergis uses those endpoints
Public job listings are our client orders or supply a candidate pool
Public wage/rate advertisements reveal realized margin
API integration or a task-count split proves a 100% autonomous staffing company or a savings percentage

review.method: Read-only challenge of existing phase2/phase3 JSON
findings_applied: Clearance recheck and restricted evidence visibility
Separate client selection, candidate consent and work readiness
Payroll independent of billing with idempotent replay
Tenant-specific connector conformance before working-status claims

reconstruction.state_machine_scope: Illustrative transition excerpts only; these are not exhaustive state graphs or executable specifications. Full transitions and negative cases are future implementation work.

independent_review.scope: Independent review of phase4 plan-core.json, portfolio.json and reconstruction.json against existing phase2/phase3 evidence.
independent_review.status: Pass for proposed product roadmap; no unresolved findings
independent_review.deployment_status: No implementation, connector, vendor access, procurement or live-operation validation was performed by this review.

checks.check: Single authoritative system per record class
checks.detail: ATS or minimal owned core is an explicit alternative; owned workflow/audit stores reference records and evidence. Contract-designated time and provider financial records retain authority.

Twelve capability areas form three shared-platform experiences; specialist services are established, while workflow/policy, controlled actions and evidence are owned. ATS vendor selection remains conditional.
Public observations, vendor documentation, proposed behavior and private unknowns are separated. No production schema, hidden data, working tenant connector or complete internal-clone claim.
Competitor jobs are market observations rather than own orders or candidate supply; public contracts and rates are examples rather than the new operator's binding terms.
Clinical services and attestations retain qualified ownership; consequential employment and finance actions have named owners. Proposed human gates are not presented as universal law.
Release slices, tests, pilots and live delegation are explicitly future criteria. No observed automation ROI, headcount replacement or 100% autonomy conclusion.
All portfolio and reconstruction source IDs resolve to phase3 sources. All portfolio/state-machine workflow IDs resolve to phase2 workflow stages.

findings.detail: Transition arrays are illustrative subsets, with some connecting and terminal transitions omitted. Label them as illustrative excerpts, not exhaustive or executable specifications, to match future specification work.
findings.resolution: Root added an explicit global state_machine_scope and a scope note on all four examples stating that transitions are illustrative, non-exhaustive and not executable specifications. Verified after edit.
